children: On November 18, 2026, Nasdaq notified Ainos that it failed to meet the $2.5 million stockholders' equity requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(1); the notice has no immediate effect on trading. Ainos has until January 4, 2027, to submit a plan to regain compliance, and Nasdaq may grant up to 180 days to demonstrate compliance if it accepts the plan.
